blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Examining existing benchmarks for grounding in 3D VLMs reveals a pervasive "semantic leakage" in the evaluation and prompting protocols: a heavy reliance on bounding boxes as spatial prompts or representation primitives. Because bounding boxes are highly informative of object categories, they introduce a shortcut for the models to neglect visual information during 3D VLM training. We demonstrate this with a "blind" LLM that, prompted only with the box coordinates, can perform surprisingly well. To further analyze this shortcut, we propose point-based grounding prompting - querying models with a single 3D point instead of a box. Under this protocol, the accuracy of the blind LLM drops from 36.4% to 18.0% on ScanNet's Nr3D, and similarly degrades for 3D VLMs (e.g. LL3DA).
  Building on this insight, we introduce P$^3$-VLM, a novel tri-pathway 3D VLM that supports point-based prompts and achieves 52.1% state-of-the-art accuracy on location-grounded captioning under this setting. To achieve this, we redesign the architecture while keeping it detector-free, scene-centric, and suitable for 3D GS inputs. P$^3$-VLM utilizes three complementary pathways (location-, task-, and context-aware), enabling strong reasoning about scenes without any bounding box dependencies. The key benefit of point-based learning is a consistent improvement across settings: P$^3$-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance under point-based grounding while also improving robustness, OOD generalization, and performance on ungrounded scene-centric 3D VQA benchmarks, reflecting its reduced reliance on bounding-box shortcuts and resulting stronger visual-spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
检查在3D VLMs中搁浅的现有基准,揭示了评价中普遍存在的"语义渗漏"和提示协议:严重依赖边框作为空间提示或表示原始. 由于边框对对象类别信息性很强,它们引入了一个快捷键,让模型在3D VLM训练中忽略视觉信息. 我们用一个“盲”LLM来证明这一点, 它只有用盒子坐标来激发, 才能令人惊讶地表现良好。 为了进一步分析这个快捷键,我们提出基于点的地面提示——用单个3D点而不是一个框查询模型. 根据这一协议,盲LLM的精度在ScanNet的Nr3D上从36.4%下降到18.0%,对于3D VLM(如LL3DA)来说,类似的降解.
基于这一见解,我们引入了P$^3$-VLM,这是一种新型的三维通道3D VLM,它支持基于点的提示,并在此设置下基于位置的字幕上达到52.1%的精度. 为了实现这一目标,我们重新设计建筑,同时保持其无探测器,以场景为中心,并适合3DGS输入. P$^3$-VLM使用三种互补途径(位置、任务和对上下文的认识),能够对场景进行有力的推理,而没有任何边框依赖性。 以点为基础的学习的主要好处是各环境之间不断改进: P$^3$-VLM在点地基下实现最先进的性能,同时提高稳健性,OOD概括性,以及以无根据场景为核心的3D VQA基准上的性能,反映出它减少了对边框快捷键的依赖,并因此加强了视觉空间推理.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold the promise of generalist scene understanding: given a 3D representation of an environment, such a model should be able to answer both grounded queries – those anchored to a specific location or object in the scene – and ungrounded queries about the scene at large [ 8 , 24 , 8 , 20 , 23 ] . Significant progress has been made in this direction, yet a fundamental question remains open: to what extent do current 3D VLMs actually observe the scene, rather than exploit contextual shortcuts?
blocks.zh: 3D Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)持有通俗主义场景理解的希望:鉴于环境的3D代表,这样的模型应该既能回答基于理由的询问 — — 那些锚定在现场的特定位置或物体上 — 也能够回答关于整个场景的无根据的询问[8, 24, 8, 20, 23]. 朝这个方向已经取得重大进展,但一个根本问题仍然有待解决:目前的3D VLM在多大程度上实际观察现场,而不是利用背景快捷方式?

blocks.en:
We investigate this question through grounded object understanding: identifying the correct object given a 3D spatial prompt. This requires jointly reasoning about geometry and semantics, including localizing the queried region, interpreting its visual content, and producing a semantically accurate response [ 11 , 6 , 19 , 18 ] .
We find that existing object- and scene-centric paradigms share a common issue of “semantic leakage” in evaluation protocols, arising from the widespread use of bounding boxes as either prompts or representation primitives. Because bounding boxes carry strong categorical cues through their size, shape, and aspect ratio, they enable shortcut solutions (e.g., a tall narrow box often corresponds to a door; beds have standardized measurements) that reduce the need for true visual-spatial reasoning. They also implicitly assume accurate object localization, which is usually unrealistic in real-world 3D applications.
blocks.zh:
我们通过基于物体的理解来调查这个问题:在3D空间速率下确定正确的物体。 这需要共同对几何学和语义学进行推理,包括将被询问区域本地化,解释其视觉内容,并产生精密准确的反应[11,6,19,18].
我们发现,现有的以物体和场景为中心的范式在评价协议中有一个共同的“语义渗漏”问题,其起因是广泛使用边框作为提示或表示原始物。 由于捆绑箱通过大小,形状,和侧面比来携带强烈的绝对提示,它们可以实现捷径解决方案(例如,一个高大的窄箱往往对应一个门;床位有标准化的测量),从而减少了对真实视觉空间推理的需求. 他们还含蓄地假设了准确的对象本地化,这在现实世界3D应用中通常是不现实的.

blocks.en: The box dependency appears across both object-centric VLMs [ 24 , 23 , 58 ] , which inherit box-based object representations from detectors, and scene-centric models [ 19 , 8 ] , which still rely on bounding boxes as grounding prompts at inference time. As a result, models can exploit categorical priors encoded in box geometry rather than visual evidence. We demonstrate this effect by showing that a blind LLM trained only on bounding box coordinates, without any visual input, achieves 36.4 % 36.4\% accuracy on Nr3D as shown in Fig. 1 . We further show that the overreliance on bounding boxes makes the existing 3D VLMs fragile, leading to significant degradation in scenarios with atypical object sizes, noisy reconstructions, or poorly aligned bounding boxes in Fig. 2 (robustness analysis).
blocks.zh: 以物体为中心的VLM[24,23,58] 和以场景为中心的模型[19,8] 都出现对盒子的依赖,它们仍然依赖边框作为推论时间的抛锚提示。 因此,模型可以利用框几何中编码的绝对前缀而不是视觉证据. 我们通过显示盲目LLM只训练在边框坐标上,而没有任何视觉输入来证明这种效果,如图1所示,在Nr3D上达到36.4%的精度。 我们进一步表明,过分依赖边框使现有的立体VLM变得脆弱,导致在非典型物体大小、重建吵闹或图2中的边框不太对齐的情况下出现严重退化(硬度分析)。

blocks.en: These findings motivate both a new evaluation protocol and a new model design. We propose point-based grounding prompting , where queries are specified using only a single 3D point on the target object. Unlike bounding boxes, point prompts do not reveal object shape or extent, substantially reducing category-specific geometric cues and incentivizing models to rely on genuine visual-spatial understanding. Under this stricter protocol, the shortcut enabled by bounding boxes largely disappears: the accuracy of the blind LLM drops sharply from 36.4 % 36.4\% to 18.0 % 18.0\% on Nr3D. Existing 3D VLMs, including scene-centric models such as [ 19 , 8 ] , also degrade substantially, further exposing their overreliance on bounding-box cues (e.g. LL3DA drops from 47.7 % 47.7\% to 33.1 % 33.1\% , see Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 这些结果既推动了新的评价协议,也推动了新的模型设计。 我们提出基于点的地面提示,其中仅使用目标对象上的单个3D点来指定询问. 与边框不同,点提示不显示对象形状或范围,大幅降低类别特定几何提示,激励模型依赖真正的视觉空间理解. 在这个更严格的协议下,边框允许的快捷键基本消失:盲LLM的精度在Nr3D上从36.4%的36.4\%急剧下降至18.0%的18.0\%. 现有的3D VLM,包括以场景为中心的模型,如[19,8],也大幅降解,进一步暴露了对边框提示的过度依赖(例如LL3DA从47.7% 47.7%下降到33.1%,参见图1)。

blocks.en: To address this new challenging setting, where existing scene-centric 3D VLMs struggle, we introduce P 3 -VLM , a detector-free, scene-centric 3D VLM built on 3D Gaussian scene representations (3D GS) and designed specifically for point-based grounding. P 3 -VLM utilizes a tri-pathway architecture consisting of: (1) a location-aware pathway that encodes compact positional cues from the query point, (2) a task-aware pathway that sparsifies and refines query-relevant volumetric features, and (3) a context-aware pathway that summarizes the global scene for grounded reasoning. By anchoring visual features directly to scene voxels rather than detector-derived geometry, P 3 -VLM enables spatially grounded reasoning under the proposed point-based alternative.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这种新的挑战性环境,即现有的以场景为中心的3D VLM斗争,我们引入了P 3 - VLM,一种基于3D高斯场景表现(3D GS)的无探测器,以场景为中心的3D VLM,专门为点基地面设计. P 3 - VLM使用三通路架构,包括:(1) 定位感知路径,从查询点编码紧凑的位置提示;(2) 任务感知路径,将与查询相关的音量特性压缩和完善;(3) 上下文感知路径,将全球场景归纳为有根据的推理。 P3-VLM通过将视觉特征直接固定在场景阴极上,而不是探测器衍生的几何学上,使得在提议的基于点的替代品下能够进行空间上的基础推理。

blocks.en:
Under point-based grounding, P 3 -VLM achieves 52.4 % 52.4\% class accuracy on Nr3D, substantially outperforming both the blind LLM baseline ( 18.0 % 18.0\% ) and previous 3D VLMs adapted to this setting ( 33.1 % 33.1\% and 29.3 % 29.3\% for LL3DA and GaussianVLM, respectively; see Tab. 2 ). This large margin demonstrates that its visual encoder is genuinely load-bearing. Moreover, by avoiding bounding-box shortcuts, P 3 -VLM is not only more robust but also exhibits stronger scene-level OOD generalization (see Fig. 2 ), while maintaining consistent gains on ungrounded scene understanding benchmarks such as ScanQA [ 3 ] and SQA3D [ 33 ] .
Overall, this work makes the following contributions: • We identify bounding box leakage as a pervasive shortcut in current 3D VLMs, hurting visual-spatial understanding, and introduce point-based grounding as a stricter protocol. • We present P 3 -VLM, a detector-free, scene-centric 3D VLM operating on 3D Gaussian representations via three complementary pathways (location, task, and context aware). • We show that P 3 -VLM achieves SOTA performance under point-based grounding while improving robustness, OOD generalization, and performance on VQA benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
在点定位下,P 3 - VLM在Nr3D上达到52.4%的52.4%的类精度,大大超过了盲目LLM基线(18.0% 18.0%%)和以前适应此设置的3D VLM(LL3DA和Gaussian VLM分别为33.1% 33.1% 和29.3% ) 。 这一大比值表明其视觉编码器真正具有负载性。 此外,P 3 - VLM通过避免边框快捷键,不仅更加坚固,而且展现了更强的场景级OOD概括(见图2),同时在ScanQA[3]和SQA3D[33]等没有根据的场景理解基准上保持一致的收益.
总体而言,这项工作做出了以下贡献: 我们确定边框渗漏是当前3D VLM 中普遍存在的捷径,会损害视觉-空间理解,并将基于点的搁浅作为更严格的协议。 我们提出P 3 - VLM,这是一个无探测器、以场景为中心的3D VLM,通过三个互补途径(位置、任务和背景意识)运行在3D Gaussian代表上。 我们显示,P 3 - VLM在点基础上实现SOTA性能,同时提高稳健性、OOD概括性以及VQA基准性能。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D-Grounded Scene Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 3D环形场景理解

blocks.en:
3D-grounded scene understanding refers to tasks involving visual grounding in 3D space, which can manifest on either the input or the output side of the model [ 6 , 1 , 19 , 34 , 30 ] .
On the output side, the model receives a reference to an object or category and must predict a spatial specification for the matching object(s) – a 3D bounding box or segmentation mask [ 34 , 28 , 30 , 32 , 2 , 52 , 27 , 42 ] . Specialist models for this setting [ 28 , 30 ] , including those built on language backbones [ 34 , 52 , 2 ] , achieve strong performance by combining task-specific pretraining, structured output modeling, and dedicated detection heads. However, because of this specialization, the state-of-the-art methods sacrifice their free-form answer and thus generalist capabilities.
Generalist models with multi-task open-language capabilities [ 8 , 23 , 24 ] have been unable to match specialist performance on output-side grounding, lacking, for instance, the structured output modeling and full-scale task-specific supervision.
Furthermore, existing free-form benchmarks for diverse scene understanding are largely restricted to ScanNet-scale datasets [ 3 , 33 , 20 , 24 , 25 , 6 , 1 , 19 ] , hindering the training of generalist models for output-side grounding at the scale necessary to achieve state-of-the-art performance [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh:
3D定位场景理解是指在3D空间进行视觉定位的任务,可以在模型的输入或输出侧[6, 1, 19, 34, 30]上显示.
在输出方面,模型收到一个对象或类别的引用,必须预测匹配对象的空间规格——一个3D边框或分区罩[34,28,30,32,2,52,27,42]. 这种设置的专家模型[28,30],包括基于语言主干线的模型[34,52,2],通过结合特定任务预训,结构化输出模型,以及专用检测头,实现强效. 然而,由于这种专业化,最先进的方法牺牲了他们的自由形式答案,从而牺牲了通俗主义的能力.
具有多任务开放语言能力的通用模型[8,23,24]在输出侧地面上无法匹配专家的性能,例如缺乏结构化的产出模型和针对任务的全面监督.
此外,现有各种场景理解的自由形式基准主要限于ScanNet尺度数据集[3、33、20、24、25、6、1、19],妨碍了对产出方模型的培训,使其无法在达到最先进性能所需的范围内进行定位[34]。

blocks.en: Input-side grounded understanding entails providing the grounding on the input side through a 3D location query, with model output – a caption of the referenced object [ 19 , 8 , 18 , 58 , 24 , 56 ] . This setting is more compatible with open-form answer models. Some free-form VLMs also report bounding box outputs in this setting, yet those are obtained via independent, frozen detectors [ 9 , 41 ] entirely separate from their core architecture [ 8 , 23 , 24 ] , making the box prediction not a product of the model’s learned visual understanding. Exploring free-form 3D generalist VLMs, we operate in the input-side captioning setting [ 19 , 18 , 56 ] . The captioning quality directly measures the VLM’s visual understanding, not focusing on box predictions, obtainable through an external module.
blocks.zh: 输入方基于理解,需要通过3D定位查询,在输入方上打地基,模型输出 — 参考对象的标题[19、8、18、58、24、56]。 此设置与开放形式解答模式更加兼容. 一些自由形式的VLM也报告在此设置中的捆绑框输出,然而这些输出却通过独立,冷冻的探测器[9,41]完全独立于其核心架构[8,23,24],使得盒的预测不是该模型所学到的视觉理解的产物. 探索自由形式3D通论VLM,我们在输入侧标题设置中运行[19,18,56]. 标题质量直接衡量VLM的视觉理解,而不是专注于盒式预测,可以通过外部模块获取。

blocks.en: 2.2 3D VLMs for Multi-Task Scene Reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.2 多任务场景的3D VLM

blocks.en:
VLMs for 3D scenes aim to support a broad range of tasks, including object captioning [ 6 , 1 ] , question answering [ 3 , 20 ] , spatial reasoning [ 33 , 54 ] and beyond [ 19 , 20 ] , through a single unified model [ 19 , 8 , 55 , 39 ] .
The dominant paradigm in this setting has been
object-centric: detect a set of object proposals, encode their point
cloud features to separate tokens, and align them with language [ 54 , 24 , 23 , 29 , 57 , 47 , 53 , 10 , 46 , 31 , 10 ] . Prior research suggests that this approach is fundamentally limited as scene-level understanding is bounded by detector recall [ 19 ] , and is emergent rather than by design [ 19 , 56 , 36 , 16 ] .
Thus, a parallel line of work moves away from detector dependencies, spanning video VLMs for 3D understanding [ 17 , 55 , 39 , 22 , 7 , 49 , 45 ] , and native 3D models.
The latter processes 3D scenes either (1) in a region-based manner requiring incorporation of advanced methods for instilling cross-regional awareness (e.g., GCNs [ 18 ] ) or (2) via scene-centric strategies that encode the environment at once as a whole [ 19 , 8 , 56 ] .
GaussianVLM [ 19 ] pioneered the use of 3D GS for scene-centric understanding and acts as a baseline for this work. However, it suffers from reduced robustness and generalization due to reliance on semantic shortcuts (Sec. 3.2 , 5 , D.3 ).
blocks.zh:
3D场景的VLM旨在支持广泛的任务,包括对象标题[6,1],问题回答[3,20],空间推理[33,54]和之后[19,20],通过单一的统一模型[19,8,55,39].
在这个背景下的主导范式是:
对象中心: 检测一组对象提案, 编码其点
云形特征以分别符,与语言[54,24,23,29,57,47,53,10,46,31,10]一致. 先前的研究表明,由于场景层面的理解以探测器召回[19]为界限,因此这种方法根本上是有限的,并且是现成的而不是设计[19、56、36、16]。
因此,平行的工作线脱离了探测器的依赖性,跨越视频VLM,用于3D理解[17,55,39,22,7,49,45],以及本地3D模型.
后者处理三维场景:(1) 以基于区域的方式,要求采用先进的方法,灌输跨区域的认识(例如,全球网络[18]),或者(2) 通过以场景为中心的战略,同时将整个环境编码[19、8、56]。
GaussianVLM [19]率先使用3D GS来进行以场景为中心的理解,并作为这项工作的基线. 然而,由于依赖语义快捷方式,其强度和通俗性下降(第3.2、5、D.3条)。

blocks.en: 3 From Bounding Box Semantic Leakage to Point Grounding
blocks.zh: 3 从边框语义渗出到点地

blocks.en:
A foundational assumption underlying 3D VLM evaluation is that grounded query performance reflects genuine visual-spatial reasoning – an assumption which we investigate in this section. When models are queried about a specific object via a bounding box prompt – the universal convention across 3D VLMs – the box itself encodes strong categorical information: its dimensions, aspect ratio,
and volume are highly predictive of object class. A tall, narrow box standing up from floor level implies a door; a box with measurements of a queen-sized bed – a bed, etc. We term this phenomenon bounding box semantic leakage and demonstrate that it acts as a dominant signal that can bypass visual perception in 3D VLMs when it comes to grounding tasks.
blocks.zh:
一个基于3D VLM评价的基础假设是,基于查询的性能反映了真实的视觉-空间推理,我们在本节中对此进行了调查。 当模型通过一个边框的提示(3D VLMs的通用公约)被问及特定对象时,该选项本身就编码了强烈的绝对信息:它的尺寸,宽比,
并且体积对物体类具有高度的预测性. 一个高大的,狭长的盒子从地板上站起,意味着一个门;一个有王后大小床位测量的盒子——一张床等. 我们用这个现象来形容框语义的渗漏,并表明它作为一个主导信号,可以在3D VLMs中绕过视觉感知到地面任务.

blocks.en: To investigate this phenomenon, we focus on the task of 3D-Grounded Object Captioning, which requires a model to generate a natural language description for a specific object given a spatial query. We evaluate various 3D VLMs on two ScanNet-based benchmarks: Nr3D [ 1 ] and ScanRefer [ 6 ] . Firstly, we evaluate models under the standard prompting protocol, bounding-box prompting , specifying the query location as a box center and extent.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这一现象,我们专注于3D-Grounded Object Caption(3D-Grounded Object Caption)的任务,它需要一种模型来生成给定空间查询的特定物体的自然语言描述. 我们根据两个基于ScanNet的基准,即Nr3D[1]和ScanRefer,评估各种3D VLM [6]. 首先,我们评估标准提示协议下的模型,边框提示,指定查询位置为框中心和范围.

blocks.en: 3.1 Bounding Box Semantic Leakage
blocks.zh: 3.1 包装箱语义泄漏

blocks.en: Table 1: Object-centric VLMs do not utilize their 3D encoder. A blind LLM operating on bounding box coordinates alone, and an LLM with only box coordinate embeddings, perform close to the full OD-VLM on Nr3D.
blocks.zh: 表1:以物体为中心的VLM不使用其3D编码器. 一个盲LLM单独在边框坐标上运行,和一个只有边框坐标嵌入的LLM,在Nr3D上执行接近全OD-VLM.

blocks.en:
We aim to isolate the contribution of geometric priors from other key aspects of 3D grounding such as semantics and context awareness. For this, we conduct two controlled experiments on Nr3D.
Specifically, we examine the effect of the strong reliance on bounding boxes within the textual and/or the visual component of the prompt, highlighting that the leakage can occur via both information channels and cause over-reliance on this geometric prior rather than utilization of rich visual features.
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是将几何学前科的贡献与立体定位的其他关键方面,如语义学和背景意识区分开来。 为此,我们在Nr3D上进行了两次受控实验.
具体地说,我们审视了在文字和(或)视觉部分中强烈依赖边框的影响,强调渗漏既可通过信息渠道发生,又会导致过度依赖这种几何前的而不是丰富的视觉特征。

blocks.en: First, we examine the effect of bounding boxes as grounding prompts within the textual LLM task prompt. We fine-tune a "blind" LLM (Qwen3-VL 4B Instruct LLM [ 4 ] ) via LoRA to predict object classes from box center, yaw and extent alone, with no visual encoder of any kind. The fine-tuned blind LLM achieves 36% class accuracy – a significant result that establishes box geometry as a strong categorical signal independent of any visual observation.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们审查在文字LLM任务提示中将框作为抛锚提示的效果。 我们通过LORA来微调一个"盲"LLM(Quen3-VL 4B 指示LLM [4]),以预测对象类别,从箱中心,yaw和范围单独预测,没有任何类型的视觉编码器. 微调的盲LLM实现了36%的类精度 — — 这一显著的结果将框几何确定为独立于任何视觉观察的强烈的绝对信号.

blocks.en: Leakage can also occur through the visual channel, particularly in Object-Detector VLMs (OD-VLMs). These models typically use a decoupled architecture: a detector segments the scene, and a 3D encoder transforms each instance’s point cloud into tokens for the LLM. We investigate whether the 3D encoder contributes meaningful semantic understanding beyond what the detector’s box metadata already provides.
blocks.zh: 泄漏也可通过视觉通道发生,特别是在物体探测器VLMs(OD-VLMs)中. 这些模型通常使用一个解耦的架构:一个探测器将场景分解,一个3D编码器将每个实例的点云转换成LLM的符号. 我们调查3D编码器是否有助于有意义的语义理解,超出探测器的盒式元数据已经提供的范围.

blocks.en:
We ask whether the visual encoder in a full object-centric VLM is strongly utilized on top of this prior. For this, we evaluate an OD-VLM (LEO [ 24 ] ) against a modified version where the visual features are simply encodings of the bounding boxes (center and extent) of the objects within the scene, derived with a lightweight 2-layer MLP.
We observe very close performance of the two models (Tab. 1 ). These results suggest that, under bounding-box-based visual prompting, object class predictions are once again driven primarily by geometric priors rather than visual features.
blocks.zh:
我们问,是否在前面的上面大力使用了完全以物体为中心的VLM中的视觉编码器。 为此,我们对一个OD-VLM(LEO [24])与一个修改后的版本进行了评价,其中的视觉特征仅仅是场景内物体的边框(中心及范围)的编码,其衍生出一个轻量级的2层MLP.
我们观测到两种模式非常接近的表现(第1段)。 这些结果表明,在基于边框的视觉提示下,对象类预测再次主要由几何前兆而不是视觉特征驱动.

blocks.en: 3.2 Point-Based Grounding
blocks.zh: 3.2 点地基

blocks.en: Our findings indicate that the prevalent use of bounding boxes as spatial prompts may provide geometric priors that simplify the grounding task. To isolate visual perception from these structural cues, we propose point-based grounding prompting : a protocol where location queries are specified as a single 3D coordinate ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) . By removing information about the target’s extent or aspect ratio, it serves as a more faithful benchmark for a model’s ability to extract semantics from visual features.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,普遍使用边框作为空间提示可能提供几何前兆,从而简化搁浅任务。 为了将视觉感知从这些结构提示中分离出来,我们提议基于点的地面提示: 指定位置查询为单一3D坐标(x,y,z) (x,y,z)的协议. 通过删除有关目标范围或侧面比的信息,它成为模型从视觉特征中提取语义学能力更忠实的基准.

blocks.en: The effect of removing box geometry is immediate. We fine-tune two variants of the blind LLM: one trained on bounding box prompts and evaluated accordingly, and one trained and evaluated on point-based prompts (Supp. Sec. A.1 ). Class accuracy drops from 36.4% to 18.0% (Tab. 2 ) – a 50% relative reduction achieved by changing only the prompt format, with no modification to the model architecture. This confirms the prior inherent in the bounding-box grounding prompts, and its reduced effect in point prompts.
blocks.zh: 删除框几何的效果是即时的. 我们微调了盲目LLM的两个变体:一个是接受过定界框提示和相应评价的培训,另一个是接受过定点提示的培训和评价(Supp. Sec. A.1 )。 类精度从36.4%下降到18.0%(Tab. 2)——仅通过改变即时格式实现了50%的相对减少,对模型架构没有修改. 这证实了绑定框搁浅提示的内在作用,及其在点提示中作用的减弱.

blocks.en: We then ask whether existing scene-centric VLMs can close this gap when adapted to the new prompt. For each model, we fine-tune on point-based grounding and re-evaluate under the stricter protocol (training details in the Supplementary A.1 ). The results in Tab. 2 show that fine-tuning does recover some performance, yet a substantial gap relative to the box-based baseline persists across all models: on Nr3D LL3DA drops from 47.7% to 33.1%, and GaussianVLM from 46.2% to 29.3%. The fact that explicit training on point prompts does not close this gap suggests that the limitation is not one of prompt formatting, but of visual capacity – these models have not developed the dense visual representations that point-based grounding demands.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们问,现有的以场景为中心的VLM在适应新的提示时是否能够弥合这一差距。 对于每一种模式,我们根据更严格的协议(补充A.1中的培训细节),对点基基础进行微调和重新评价。 塔布结果. 2 显示微调确实恢复了一些性能,但在所有模型中,与基于箱的基线相比仍存在很大差距:Nr3D LL3DA从47.7%下降到33.1%,高斯VLM从46.2%下降到29.3%。 关于点提示的明确训练并没有弥合这一差距,这表明限制不是即时格式化,而是视觉能力 — — 这些模型还没有发展出密集的视觉表现,即基于点定位的要求.

Also the 3D VLM baselines (LL3DA, GaussianVLM) trained on boxes drop considerably even after fine-tuning on point prompts.

blocks.en:
P 3 -VLM is a scene-centric 3D VLM, that takes as input 3D Gaussian Splats (GS) and a natural language query and produces a free-form language response relying on point-based spatial prompting.
An overview of the architecture is shown in Fig. 3 .
The scene is first voxelized: a sparse 3D GS encoder processes the raw Gaussian splats into a set of voxel features F ∈ ℝ N × D F\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D} with associated 3D coordinates C ∈ ℝ N × 3 C\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times 3} , where each feature is anchored to a specific spatial location. These voxel features then feed three complementary pathways: location-aware, task-aware, and context-aware, which together produce the visual token sequence as input to the LLM. To the visual tokens, we append the user language task tokens L L .

blocks.en:
The 3D visual encoder produces rich, yet dense, visual features. Even for our downsampled scans, this can produce more than 10k tokens, which are computationally heavy to be processed as a sequence in the attention mechanism.
To alleviate this, we sparsify the dense visual features by aggregation and refinement, which additionally increases their spatial awareness, to make them consumable by the context and task pathways.
Notably, the location pathway operates on raw encoder features as it focuses exclusively on locality rather than global awareness.
Detailed implementation specifications and hyperparameter choices are provided in Supp. Sec. D .

为了缓解这种情况,我们通过集聚和精细化这些密集的视觉特征,这又增加了它们的空间意识,使它们能通过上下文和任务路径来消耗。

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We follow standard training protocols within the scene-centric 3D VLM field [ 8 , 19 ] and train our models within the ScanNet [ 15 ] settings. Notably, we use 3D GS representation [ 30 ] as visual input. We perform joint training on multiple of tasks without task-specific fine-tuning: general question-answering (ScanQA [ 3 ] ), situated question-answering (SQA3D [ 33 ] ) and location-grounded captioning (on Nr3D [ 1 ] , ScanRefer [ 6 ] ).
blocks.zh: 我们遵循以场景为中心的3D VLM场 [8,19] 的标准训练协议,并在ScanNet [15] 设置中训练我们的模型. 值得注意的是,我们使用3DGS代表[30]作为视觉输入. 我们就多项任务进行联合培训,不进行具体任务的微调:一般性问答(ScanQA[3])、定位问答(SQA3D[33])和定位定位字幕(Nr3D[1],ScanRefer[6])。

blocks.en: Following baseline protocols [ 19 ] , we evaluate question-answering on a multitude of metrics covering linguistic similarity (METEOR (M) [ 5 ] , ROUGE (R) [ 12 ] , BLEU-4 (B4) [ 35 ] , CIDEr (C) [ 44 ] ), and exact-match accuracy. For the latter, we adopt the refined EM protocol (EM-R) [ 24 ] . For captioning, we evaluate target object identification via accuracy (Acc) and caption similarity via Sentence-BERT Similarity (Sim) [ 40 ] , with metrics discussion provided in Supp. Sec. A.2 . Results are reported on the validation sets of ScanRefer, Nr3D, ScanQA and test set of SQA3D.
blocks.zh: 遵循基线协议[19],我们评价对涉及语言相似性(METEOR(M)[5],ROUGE(R)[12],BLEU-4(B4)[35],CIDER(C)[44]))的多种计量标准的问答,以及准确的匹配精确度。 就后者而言,我们通过了经过改进的EM议定书(EM-R)[24]。 关于标题,我们通过精确度(Acc)来评价目标对象的识别,通过句子-BERT相似度(Sim)来评价标题的相似性[40],在Supp中提供了衡量标准的讨论。 A.2节 有关ScanRefer、Nr3D、ScanQA和SQA3D测试集的验证结果也作了报告。

blocks.en:
Training is carried out in two stages. In the first stage, only the location-aware pathway is active, with the model being trained on
point-based grounded captioning (Nr3D and ScanRefer), using the single location token as the sole visual input. This
allows the location extractor to learn a stable voxel-to-language mapping before the full scene representation is introduced.
In the second stage, all three pathways are active and the model is trained jointly on the full task mixture. Both stages are trained under the standard autoregressive language modeling objective (Supp. Sec. A.5 ).

基于点的基于点的字幕(Nr3D和ScanRefer),以单一位置符号作为唯一的视觉输入. 这个
允许位置提取器在引入完整的场景表现之前学习稳定的Voxel到语言映射.
在第二阶段,这三条道路都非常活跃,该模型是联合对全任务混合物的培训。 这两个阶段都根据标准自动语言建模目标(Supp. Sec. A.5)进行了培训。

blocks.en:
P 3 -VLM uses Qwen3-VL-4B [ 4 ] as LLM backbone, fine-tuned with LoRA [ 21 ] with rank 16 [ 19 , 24 ] .
The 3D encoder is initialized from SceneSplat [ 30 ] and kept unfrozen. The three visual pathway components are trained from scratch. Training takes 10 hours on 2 NVIDIA-H200 GPUs with 5 epochs of pre-training the location pathway, followed by 12 epochs of full model training, using batch size 16 across both stages. We use the AdamW optimizer with a cosine annealing learning rate schedule, learning rate 3e-5 and weight decay of 0.05. We perform evaluation every epoch. For further training and hyperparameter details, please refer to Supp. Sec. A.5 . We train and evaluate two variants of P 3 -VLM differing solely in the adopted location prompting strategy - bounding box ( P 3 -VLM (b) with box format [center, yaw, extent] ) or point ( P 3 -VLM (p) ). For the latter we use the centers of the objects, derived from the ground truth segmentation [ 15 ] .

blocks.en: 5.2 Grounded Object Understanding

blocks.en: Even point prompts are not entirely free of priors: absolute coordinates can still correlate with object category through scene-layout regularities. We examine and quantify these residual priors with a geometry-only kNN classifier, trained on the Nr3D train split and evaluated on the validation split (38 classes with at least 8 instances). Using the object center as the point prompt, the horizontal position ( x ​ y xy ) alone yields 8.1 % 8.1\% accuracy, the height ( z z ) alone 17.8 % 17.8\% , and the full 3D center ( x ​ y ​ z xyz ) 16.5 % 16.5\% , compared to 33.0 % 33.0\% for the full bounding box. Height thus accounts for nearly all of the residual signal, while absolute room position is a weak cue. Per class, the center-based kNN reaches ≥ 30 % \geq 30\% recall on only 3/38 classes (chair, picture, monitor), compared to 15/38 for the box-based one: the residual prior is confined to objects with a consistent mounting or placement height, whereas shape-distinctive objects (e.g., bed, keyboard, door) leak almost entirely through box geometry.

The bounding boxes provide a categorical prior that often does not hold in noisy or out-of-distribution data, e.g., spaces with larger cabinets or larger windows.
We evaluate two failure regimes. (1) Non-tight bounding boxes, produced by imperfect detectors or coarse annotations, dilute the geometric signal that the model has come to depend on. (2) Noisy or partial reconstructions introduce geometric artifacts that corrupt box estimates further.

blocks.en: 5.4 Ungrounded Scene Understanding
blocks.zh: 5.4 无根据的场景理解

blocks.en:
We further examine the generalist capabilities of P 3 -VLM on three ungrounded scene understanding benchmarks: ScanQA, SQA3D, and GaussianVLM out-of-distribution benchmark (GaussianVLM-OOD) [ 19 ] (Tables 6 , 8 , 8 ). The latter probes VLM generalization on an object counting task on out-of-distribution ScanNet++ scenes [ 50 ] , measured via exact match accuracy (EM).
P 3 -VLM (p) achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three benchmarks, surpassing the state-of-the-art GaussianVLM on most metrics despite being trained with the strictly harder point-based prompting protocol.
On the ungrounded scene-level OOD benchmark, P 3 -VLM (p) reaches 17.31 EM versus 9.3 for GaussianVLM, with P 3 -VLM (b) scoring 15.42. The +1.89 EM advantage of (p) over (b) on this benchmark indicates that removing bounding box supervision improves out-of-distribution robustness, consistent with our hypothesis that point-based training discourages reliance on box-derived shortcuts and encourages stronger visual representations.

P 3 - VLM(p) 在所有三个基准中都实现了最先进的性能,在大多数度量标准上超过了最先进的高斯VLM,尽管接受了严格较硬的点基提示协议的培训.

blocks.en: 5.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: We evaluate the contribution of different components within P 3 -VLM through a series of ablation studies considering our tri-pathway design (Tab. 9 ) with ablations on the design of separate components provided in Supp. Sec. C . Our ablations cover location-grounded and ungrounded tasks with both object-level and scene-level understanding focus.
blocks.zh: 我们评估P 3-VLM内部不同部件的贡献,为此进行了一系列的消蚀研究,同时考虑到我们的三条路径设计(第9段),同时对Supp中提供的单独部件的设计进行点缀。 中枢 我们的战舰覆盖了定位和未定位的任务,既包括对象级,也包括场景级的理解焦点.

blocks.en: We show the necessity of understanding 3D scenes at three levels of granularity by ablating the three pathways of P 3 -VLM. Removing any pathway causes consistent drops in task performance. Notably, the location pathway proves an important component enabling scene-level tasks (SQA3D), although it is used only with location-based queries. As we observe, it allows the other two pathways to focus on scene-level understanding rather than generalist capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们通过铺设P 3-VLM的三条路径,表明在三个颗粒级上理解三维场景的必要性. 删除任何路径都会导致任务性能持续下降. 值得注意的是,位置路径证明,它是一个重要组成部分,能够执行场景级别的任务(SQA3D),尽管它只用于基于位置的查询。 正如我们所观察到的,它使得其他两种途径能够侧重于场景层面的理解而不是泛泛论能力.

blocks.en: To fully isolate the contribution of our visual processing, we construct a matched baseline that shares the 3D encoder and LLM with P 3 -VLM, but uses more simplistic visual features: the query point is represented by the raw feature of its nearest voxel, and scene information is provided only via the context tokens, i.e., without our location MLP and without the task pathway. The matched baseline falls far behind P 3 -VLM on point-based grounding (Nr3D: 39.8 % 39.8\% vs. 52.1 % 52.1\% , ScanRefer: 44.2 % 44.2\% vs. 56.1 % 56.1\% Acc), showing that the pathway choices and their design are well-motivated.
blocks.zh: 为了完全隔离我们视觉处理的贡献,我们构建了一个匹配的基线,将3D编码器和LLM与P 3-VLM共享,但使用更简单的视觉特征:查询点以它最近的voxel的原始特征为代表,场景信息仅通过上下文符号提供,即没有我们的位置MLP和任务路径. 相应的基线远远落后于P 3 - VLM的点地基(Nr3D:39.8% 39.8\%对52.1% 52.1\%,ScanRefer:44.2% 44.2\%对56.1% 56.1\%Acc),表明路径选择及其设计有良好的动机.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we highlight the problem of semantic leakage in current 3D VLMs, causing these models to neglect visual information.
We propose a new point-based grounding prompting protocol and show that other methods struggle under this new setting.
To address this, we present P 3 -VLM, a novel 3D VLM based on a tri-pathway design.
We demonstrate the proposed point-based grounding approach with our architecture leads to improved visual understanding, demonstrated through improved performance, generalization, and robustness on multiple 3D tasks and benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们强调当前3D VLM中的语义渗漏问题,导致这些模型忽略视觉信息.
我们提出一个新的基于点的催化协议,并表明其他方法在这一新环境下挣扎。
为了解决这个问题,我们提出了P 3 - VLM,一种基于三条路径设计的小说3D VLM.
我们用我们的架构展示了拟议的以点为基础的基础方法,通过改进业绩、概括和在多个三维任务和基准上的稳健性,提高了视觉理解。

blocks.en:
First, P 3 -VLM requires 3D GS representations as input, introducing an extra reconstruction step that adds complexity; however, this step has been performed at
scale in prior works [ 30 , 32 ] and industrial applications [ 38 , 14 ] , and is shown to yield richer visual features [ 19 ] .
Second, our evaluation is primarily focused on perception-oriented benchmarks, with limited coverage of language-intensive or dialogue-driven tasks. Extending P 3 -VLM to more complex multimodal reasoning settings remains an important direction for future work.
Third, our approach relies on voxelized visual features, currently obtained via the SceneSplat encoder. Evaluating how well the method generalizes to alternative 3D visual encoders is an interesting avenue for further investigation.
blocks.zh:
第一,P3-VLM要求3D一般事务代表作为投入,引入了一个增加复杂性的额外重建步骤;然而,这一步骤是在
在以往作品[30、32]和工业应用[38、14]中,并显示具有较丰富的视觉特征[19]。
第二,我们的评价主要侧重于注重感知的基准,对语言密集或对话驱动的任务的覆盖面有限。 将P 3 - VLM扩展至更为复杂的多式联运推理环境仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。
第三,我们的方法依赖于目前通过SceneSplaint编码器获得的阴性视觉特征。 评估该方法对备选的3D视觉编码器的普及程度,是进一步调查的有趣途径。

blocks.en: We envision this work as a step toward enabling real-world applications such as high-level planning for navigation and visual assistance systems. Additionally, we hope it draws attention to the issue of information leakage in 3D grounding, encouraging the development of more robust and general-purpose 3D vision-language models.
blocks.zh: 我们设想这项工作是朝着实现诸如导航和视觉协助系统高级别规划等现实世界应用迈出的一步。 此外,我们希望它提请注意三维地面上的信息泄漏问题,鼓励开发更有力和通用的三维视觉语言模型。

blocks.en: We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct [ 4 ] on object classification within the Nr3D validation set under two prompt conditions: bounding box and point location. In both cases, the location query is provided as a text string with coordinates rounded to two decimal places. blocks.en: A.2 N-gram Metrics Conceal Failures in Spatial Understanding
blocks.zh: A.2 N-gm 空间理解中的隐形失败

blocks.en: Standard 3D scene understanding benchmarks such as ScanRefer and Nr3D evaluate dense captioning models using n-gram overlap metrics – CIDEr, METEOR, ROUGE – gated by an IoU threshold of 0.25 or 0.50. While these metrics are practical for large-scale evaluation, they measure linguistic surface similarity rather than semantic correctness, and in particular are insensitive to whether the model has correctly identified the class of the referred object. A response that fluently describes the wrong object category can achieve a high n-gram score if it shares common words with the reference caption [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 标准3D场景理解基准如ScanRefer和Nr3D使用n-g重合度的度量衡-CIDER,METEOR,ROUGE-以0.25或0.50的IoU阈值入门来评价密集字幕模型. 虽然这些衡量标准对于大规模评价来说是实用的,但它们衡量语言表面的相似性而不是语义上的正确性,特别是对于模型是否正确识别了被提及对象的类别并不敏感. 一个能流利地描述错误对象类别的反应,如果与参考标题共享共同的单词[19],就可以实现高ng分数.

blocks.en: To quantify this effect, we compare the correlation of standard n-gram evaluation with class accuracy: the fraction of generated captions from which the correct object category can be extracted. This metric directly measures whether the model has understood what it is looking at, independently of linguistic fluency. As shown in Tab. 10 , models that achieve competitive n-gram scores exhibit strikingly low class accuracy – in several cases falling below a blind LLM that receives no visual input whatsoever. These results indicate that n-gram metrics systematically overestimate the spatial understanding of current 3D VLMs, and motivate the use of class accuracy as a more diagnostic evaluation criterion.
blocks.zh: 为了量化这一效果,我们比较标准n-g评价与类精度的关联性:可以提取正确对象类别的生成标题的一小部分. 这一衡量标准直接衡量该模型是否理解它所看到的,而不考虑语言流利性。 如Tab. 10所示,实现有竞争力的n-g分数的模型显示的班级精度非常低 — — 在一些情况中,低于一个盲目的LLM,而这个LLM却得不到任何视觉输入。 这些结果表明,n-g测量标准系统高估了对当前3D VLM的空间理解,并激励将类精度作为更诊断的评价标准.

blocks.en: Class accuracy is computed by extracting the primary object class from each generated caption with Gemini 2.5 Flash [ 13 ] and comparing it to the ground-truth class. Captions are processed in numbered batches with the following prompt: You are an object classification assistant. You will receive a numbered list of short scene descriptions. For each description, identify the single primary object being described. Reply ONLY with a JSON array of strings – one object class per entry, in the same order. Use simple, lowercase class names (e.g. "chair", "trash can", "table", "sofa"). If the caption is empty or doesn’t describe a recognizable object, reply with "none" for that entry. No explanations, no extra keys, no markdown fences, just the raw JSON array. Tab. 11 shows representative extractions. blocks.en: A.7 Training with Surface-Point Grounding
blocks.zh: A.7 地面定位训练

blocks.en: We acknowledge the center point being a canonical point: its height is a stable, category-specific statistic. To escape this prior, we also analyze prompting with random surface points instead. A point sampled uniformly on the object surface may lie anywhere within the object’s vertical extent, so its height no longer encodes a consistent per-category value. We retrain P 3 -VLM with random surface points as the grounding signal during training. As shown in Tab. 12 , this yields a further, substantial improvement in grounding accuracy (Nr3D: 58.8 % 58.8\% vs. 52.1 % 52.1\% for center training; ScanRefer: 64.3 % 64.3\% vs. 56.1 % 56.1\% ), while the caption similarity remains comparable. A surface-trained model evaluated on center points performs worse ( 50.1 % 50.1\% on Nr3D), as the center lies outside of its training distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们承认中心点是一个划线点:它的高度是一个稳定、具体类别的统计数字。 为了在之前逃脱,我们还用随机的表面点来分析提示。 在物体表面统一取样的点可能位于物体垂直范围内的任何地方,因此其高度不再编码一个一致的每类值. 我们重新训练P 3 - VLM,随机的表面点作为训练期间的地面信号. 如表12所示,这在打地精度方面有了进一步的大幅度提高(Nr3D:58.8% 58.8\%对52.1% 52.1\%对中心训练;ScanRefer:64.3% 64.3\%对56.1% 56.1\%),而标题的相似性仍然相当。 在中心点上评价的表面训练模型表现不佳(Nr3D上50.1%为50.1%),因为中心位于其训练分布之外。

blocks.zh: 表12:Center - vs 表面点在Nr3D和ScanRefer上搁浅. c:对象中心,sp:随机表面点. 关于表面点的培训大大提高了班级的准确性。

blocks.en:
To understand where the gain originates, we relate the per-class change in accuracy (center- to surface-point training) to the physical object size, computed from the ground-truth 3D bounding boxes. Medium-to-large furniture (tables, desks, cabinets, shelves, bookshelves, seating) improves consistently, with an average gain of 21.3 accuracy points. Small or thin objects (pillows, boxes, monitors, keyboards, cups) improve much less, by 6.2 points on average; this difference is statistically significant (Mann-Whitney U test, p = 0.014 p=0.014 ).
We attribute this behavior to the feature pooling at the query point. Prompting a large object by its center forces the visual features to be pooled from deep inside the object’s interior, or even from empty space, e.g., below a table top or inside a cabinet, yielding uninformative features. Surface points, by contrast, anchor the feature pooling directly to regions rich in visible geometry and texture, which substantially improves visual grounding for larger structures.
blocks.zh:
为了了解收益的来源,我们将精确度(中心-到表面-点训练)的每级变化与物理物体大小联系起来,从地面-真实的3D边框计算。 中到大家具(桌子、桌子、柜子、货架、书架、书架、座位)不断改善,平均收益为21.3个准确点。 小物体或细物体(皮劳,盒,显示器,键盘,杯子)的改善要少得多,平均提高6.2分;这种差异在统计学上是显著的(Mann-Whitney U测试,p=0.014 p=0.014).
我们将此行为归于查询点的功能集合. 由中心促使一个大物体将视觉特征从物体内部的深处集合起来,甚至从空地集合起来,例如,在表顶以下或柜内,产生非信息特征。 相比之下,地表点将地物集成物直接固定在富含可见几何和纹理的区域,这大大改善了对较大结构的视觉地面.

For the location pathway we consider only the location-based captioning task, as the other tasks do not utilize the pathway. First, we ablate whether scene-context information improves local information extraction. The results demonstrate better location understanding on raw voxel features ( F F ) compared to utilization of already sparsified and refined features ( 𝐒 \mathbf{S} ).We attribute this to the sparsifier smoothing voxel features through spatial self-attention, which reduces their locality – precisely the property the location pathway relies on.
We also ablate the extraction strategy comparing our MLP-based approach to FiLM location conditioning, with exact details on the FiLM alternative provided in the Supplementary. Results show that processing raw voxel features ( F F ) with an MLP strategy delivers best results.

blocks.en: D.3 Comparison to the GaussianVLM Architecture
blocks.zh: D.3 与高斯VLM的比较 建筑

blocks.en:
P 3 -VLM and GaussianVLM [ 19 ] are both scene-centric 3D GS VLMs, but are built around different priorities, from which their architectural differences follow.
GaussianVLM is semantics-oriented : it fuses language into the 3D backbone itself (per-Gaussian SigLIP2 features), so every downstream token is semantically grounded before sparsification. This favors scene-level tasks and semantic VQA, where broad semantic understanding matters more than precise spatial extent.
P 3 -VLM is geometry-oriented , designed to strengthen grounding, which leads to the following design decisions: • Context pathway. A dedicated, unconditional pathway explicitly recovers global scene semantics; GaussianVLM has no counterpart. • Task pathway. In P 3 -VLM, voxel tokens query the text, and the result is applied as a residual correction to the visual features before compression, i.e., language reshapes geometry. In GaussianVLM, text tokens query and directly select visual tokens, i.e., language selects semantics. • Location pathway. P 3 -VLM derives the local token with an MLP over the concatenated geometric and semantic features at the queried point, explicitly learning location understanding jointly with content. GaussianVLM retrieves the per-Gaussian semantic feature nearest to the query point, without a comparable geometric grounding mechanism. • Positional information. P 3 -VLM fuses positional information early via 3D RoPE, reinforcing geometry throughout the visual processing; GaussianVLM adds position as a final Fourier embedding, secondary to semantics.

GaussianVLM以语义为导向:它将语言融入3D主干本身(per-Goussian SigLIP2的特性),所以每个下游的符号在螺旋化之前都会被凝聚起来. 这有利于场景级的任务和语义VQA,其中广义的语义理解比精确的空间范围更重要.

blocks.en: D.4 Point Cloud Encoder Variant
blocks.zh: D.4 点云编码器变式

blocks.en: To assess whether P 3 -VLM generalizes beyond 3D GS inputs, we replace the SceneSplat encoder with the self-supervised point cloud encoder Sonata [ 48 ] (P 3 -VLM-PC), keeping the tri-pathway design and training protocol unchanged. Results are shown in Tab. 15 . Owing to Sonata’s large-scale pre-training, P 3 -VLM-PC achieves strong location-grounded captioning results under point prompts (Nr3D: 58.1 % 58.1\% , ScanRefer: 63.3 % 63.3\% Acc), outperforming the 3D GS variant. However, Sonata features are not language-aligned, unlike SceneSplat features, which results in lower performance on the VQA benchmarks. This shows that the tri-pathway design transfers to other 3D representations, with the choice of encoder trading off grounding against language-aligned scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 为了评估P 3 - VLM 是否概括到3D GS输入之外,我们用自我监督的点云编码器Sonata[48](P 3 - VLM-PC)来取代SceneSplate编码器,保持三路径设计和训练协议不变. 结果在 Tab. 15 中显示。 由于索纳塔的大规模预训,P 3 - VLM - PC在点提示下(Nr3D:58.1% 58.1-%,Scan Refer:63.3 % 63.3+% Acc)取得了强大的定位字幕结果,优于3D GS变体。 然而,索纳塔特征并非语言对齐,与SceneSplatz特征不同,后者导致在VQA基准上的性能较低. 这表明三路设计转移到其他3D表示,选择编码器进行交换,与语言一致的场景理解相对立.

blocks.en: Our method uses 3D GS scene input, differing from the point cloud input consumed by other methods. To ensure maximal similarity in setup to the point cloud-based methods, we use 3D GS representations with Gaussian centers initialized at the point locations from the original point clouds ("Fixed XYZ" strategy). This guarantees the exact same geometrical properties under the two setups. Our 3D GS data is consistent to the one utilized within the GaussianVLM experiments and is obtained from the GaussianWorld dataset [ 30 ] .

blocks.en: Appendix F Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录 F 影响

blocks.en: Our work aims to make a step towards VLMs with strong visual understanding capabilities, showing strong robustness and out-of-distribution generalization. With this we invision real-world utilization of 3D VLMs for applications that require free-form, open-world, spatially grounded reasoning, such as robotics, assistive technologies, and AR/VR systems.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作旨在向具有强大视觉理解能力的VLM迈出一步,表现出强烈的稳健性以及分散分布的概括性. 因此,我们设想现实世界将3D VLM用于需要自由形式、开放世界、基于空间的推理的应用,如机器人、辅助技术和AR/VR系统。

blocks.en: We also note the potential environmental implications of training VLM models such as ours. While P 3 -VLM is designed with sparsification modules and scene downsampling, its training still requires significant compute resources. With this in mind, we underscore the necessity of research into environmentally-friendly training approaches.
blocks.zh: 我们还注意到诸如我们这样的甚高压LM模式培训对环境的潜在影响。 虽然P 3 - VLM设计有溅射模块和场景下取样,但其培训仍需要大量计算资源. 有鉴于此,我们强调必须研究无害环境的培训办法。
